mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_image_task ( prompt, image_size, image_count, task_status, task_message, progress, provider_name, model_name, request_json, response_json, error_message, started_at, finished_at, created_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{prompt}, #{imageSize}, #{imageCount}, #{taskStatus}, #{taskMessage}, #{progress}, #{providerName}, #{modelName}, #{requestJson}, #{responseJson}, #{errorMessage}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{createdBy}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO ai_image_task ( prompt, image_size, image_count, task_status, task_message, progress, provider_name, model_name, request_json, response_json, error_message, started_at, finished_at, created_by, create_time ) SELECT #{prompt}, #{imageSize}, #{imageCount}, #{taskStatus}, #{taskMessage}, #{progress}, #{providerName}, #{modelName}, #{requestJson}, #{responseJson}, #{errorMessage}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{createdBy}, NOW() FROM DUAL WHERE ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_image_task WHERE created_by = #{createdBy} AND task_status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') ) < 6
mapper.select: SELECT id, prompt, image_size, image_count, task_status, task_message, progress, provider_name, model_name, request_json, response_json, error_message, started_at, finished_at, created_by, create_time FROM ai_image_task WHERE id = #{id} AND created_by = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, prompt, image_size, image_count, task_status, task_message, progress, provider_name, model_name, request_json, response_json, error_message, started_at, finished_at, created_by, create_time FROM ai_image_task WHERE created_by = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_image_task WHERE created_by = #{userId} AND task_status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_image_task SET task_status = 'RUNNING', task_message = '正在调用生图模型', progress = 10, provider_name = #{providerName}, model_name = #{modelName}, started_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE ai_image_task SET task_status = 'SUCCESS', task_message = #{message}, progress = 100, provider_name = #{providerName}, model_name = #{modelName}, response_json = #{responseJson}, finished_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_image_task SET task_status = 'FAILED', task_message = #{message}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, progress = 100, finished_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_image_task SET task_status = 'FAILED', task_message = #{message}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, progress = 100, finished_at = NOW() WHERE task_status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
